process.title: First meeting
process.text: We talk through the project, what you have already and what you need. We then quote a fixed design fee.

process.text: We agree the brief and check what is possible on your site.

process.title: Stage 2: design and planning drawings
process.text: We develop layouts, 3D views and the design and planning drawings.

process.title: Stage 3: technical design
process.text: We develop the technical design, coordinated with the engineer.

process.title: Build, if you want us to
process.text: We can then price and build what we have designed.

faqs.a: No. MF is not an architecture practice. We provide interior design, layouts, 3D visualisation, planning and design drawings, and bring in a registered architect where a project needs one.
Design is a paid service. We quote a fixed fee after the first meeting, once we know what the project needs.

faqs.q: Is the design fee taken off the build price?
faqs.a: The design fee is separate. Your design agreement sets out exactly what the fee covers.

faqs.q: Do you do structural engineering or certification?
faqs.a: No. Structural engineering design, structural calculations, engineering certification, the Assigned Certifier role and fire engineering are provided by external professionals. We coordinate our design with them.

faqs.q: I already have drawings. Do I need your design service?
faqs.a: No. We price and build from your architect's or designer's drawings and work with your design team.
Yes. Planning drawings are part of Stage 2 of our design service.
